title: Digital Coast Act
official_summary:
Digital Coast Act

This bill provides statutory authority for and revises the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration's (NOAA's) Digital Coast program. (The program currently exists under NOAA to provide data, tools, and training that communities use to manage their coastal resources.)

NOAA must focus on filling data needs and gaps for critical coastal management issues and support continued improvement in existing efforts to coordinate the acquisition and integration of key data sets needed for coastal management.

NOAA may enter into financial agreements and collect fees to carry out the program.

Additionally, NOAA may establish publicly available tools that track ocean and Great Lakes economy data for each coastal state.

summary.headline: Public Law 116-223 gives NOAA formal authority to run its Digital Coast program, which provides coastal data, tools, and training.
summary.what_it_does: The law sets up in statute the Digital Coast program that NOAA already runs to help communities manage coastal resources. NOAA must focus on filling gaps in coastal data and on improving how key coastal data sets are gathered and combined. NOAA may enter financial agreements and collect fees to carry out the program. NOAA may also build public tools that track ocean and Great Lakes economic data for each coastal state.

who_it_affects.how: They can use the NOAA data, mapping tools, and training that the program provides to plan and manage coastal resources.

who_it_affects.group: Coastal state and territorial resource managers
who_it_affects.how: They may gain access to coordinated coastal data sets and to public tools that track ocean and Great Lakes economic data for their state.

who_it_affects.group: People who pay fees for NOAA Digital Coast services
who_it_affects.how: NOAA may charge fees to help fund the program, so some users may pay for certain services or tools.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 18, 2020; the official summary does not describe a separate effective date.
